cues.en: that have been codified in a particular autocratic system,

cues.zh: 那么，一个理性的人应当无视并反对它们，
cues.en: well, then a reasonable human being should disregard and oppose them,

cues.zh: 至少在原则上如此；他可能出于某种原因，实际上并没有这样做。
cues.en: at least in principle; he may not, for some reason, do it in fact.

cues.zh: 我只想回应你的第一句话，
cues.en: I would simply like to reply to your first sentence,

cues.zh: 当你说如果你不认为你对警察发动的战争
cues.en: when you said that if you didn't consider the war you wage against the police

cues.zh: 是正义的，你就不会发动它。我想用斯宾诺莎的观点回应你，
cues.en: to be just, you wouldn't wage it. I would like to reply to you in terms of Spinoza

cues.zh: 告诉你无产阶级并不因为认为对统治阶级的战争是正义的
cues.en: and tell you that the proletariat doesn't wage war against the ruling class

cues.zh: 才发动这场战争。
cues.en: because it considers such a war to be just.

cues.zh: 无产阶级对统治阶级发动战争，是因为它想要
cues.en: The proletariat wages war against the ruling class because it wants

cues.zh: 在历史上第一次夺取权力。
cues.en: for the first time in history, to take power.

cues.zh: 因为它想要推翻权力，所以它认为这样的战争是正义的。
cues.en: And because of its will to overthrow power it considers such a war to be just.

cues.zh: 嗯，我不同意？
cues.en: Yeah, I don't agree?

cues.zh: 发动战争是为了取胜，而不是因为正义。
cues.en: One wages war to win, not because it is just.

cues.zh: 我个人不同意这一点。
cues.en: I personally don't agree with that.

cues.zh: 例如，如果我能说服自己，无产阶级取得权力
cues.en: For example, if I could convince myself that attainment of power by the proletariat

cues.zh: 会导致一个恐怖主义的警察国家，在其中自由、尊严以及
cues.en: would lead to a terroristic police state, in which freedom and dignity and

cues.zh: 体面的人际关系都会被摧毁，
cues.en: decent human relations would be destroyed,

cues.zh: 那我就不希望无产阶级掌权。
cues.en: then I wouldn't want the proletariat to take power.

cues.zh: 事实上，我认为想要这样做的唯一原因，是因为人们认为，
cues.en: In fact the only reason for wanting any such thing, I believe, is because one thinks,

cues.zh: 无论对错，某些根本的人类价值将会实现
cues.en: rightly or wrongly, that some fundamental human values will be achieved

cues.zh: 通过这种权力的转移。
cues.en: by that transfer of power.

cues.zh: 当无产阶级掌权时，很可能
cues.en: When the proletariat takes power, it may be

cues.zh: 无产阶级会对它刚刚战胜的阶级施加暴力、独裁甚至血腥的权力
cues.en: quite possible that the proletariat will exert a violent, dictatorial and even bloody power

cues.zh: 针对它刚刚战胜的那些阶级。
cues.en: towards the classes over which it has just triumphed.

cues.zh: 但如果你问我，如果无产阶级对自己施加血腥、
cues.en: But if you ask me what would happen if the proletariat exerted bloody,

cues.zh: 暴虐且不公正的权力，会发生什么，那我会说，这只可能发生在
cues.en: tyrannical and unjust power towards itself, then I would say that this could only occur

cues.zh: 无产阶级并未真正掌权，而是无产阶级之外的一个阶级、
cues.en: if the proletariat hadn't really taken power, but that a class outside the proletariat,

cues.zh: 或无产阶级内部的一群人、或官僚阶层或小资产阶级分子，
cues.en: or a group of people inside the proletariat, or a bureaucracy or petit bourgeois elements,

cues.zh: 掌了权的情况下。
cues.en: had taken power.

cues.zh: 嗯，我对那套革命理论完全不满意，
cues.en: Well, I'm not at all satisfied with that theory

cues.zh: 原因有很多，历史的和其他方面的。
cues.en: of revolution for a lot of reasons, historical and others.

cues.zh: 但即便为了论证而接受它，
cues.en: But even if one were to accept it for the sake of argument,

cues.zh: 那套理论仍然主张，无产阶级
cues.en: still that theory is maintaining that it is proper for the proletariat

cues.zh: 以暴力、血腥和不公正的方式掌权并行使权力是正当的，因为它
cues.en: to take power and exercise it in a violent and bloody and unjust fashion, because it

cues.zh: 声称——我认为这是错误的——那将带来一个更公正的社会，
cues.en: is claimed, in my opinion falsely, that that will lead to a more just society,

cues.zh: 在其中国家将会消亡，
cues.en: in which the state will wither away,

cues.zh: 在其中无产阶级将成为一个普遍阶级，等等等等。
cues.en: in which the proletariat will be a universal class and so on and so forth.

cues.zh: 要不是有那层进一步的理由，无产阶级专政这个概念，
cues.en: If it weren't for that further justification, the concept of the dictatorship of the proletariat,

cues.zh: 暴力的、血腥的，肯定就是不正义的。
cues.en: violent and bloody, will certainly be unjust.

cues.zh: 比如我，我并不是一个坚定的和平主义者。
cues.en: I for example, I am not a committed pacifist.

cues.zh: 我不会认为在任何可以想象的情况下使用暴力都是错的，
cues.en: I would not hold that it is under all imaginable circumstances wrong to use violence,

cues.zh: 尽管使用暴力在某种意义上是不正义的。
cues.en: even though use of violence is in some sense unjust.

cues.zh: 我认为人们必须权衡相对的不正义。
cues.en: I believe that one has to estimate relative injustices.

cues.zh: 但使用暴力、制造某种程度的不正义，本身只能
cues.en: But the use of violence and the creation of some degree of injustice can only itself

cues.zh: 基于这样一种主张和评估来证成——而这种评估始终应当
cues.en: be justified on the basis of the claim and the assessment -- which always ought

cues.zh: 非常、非常认真地、带着相当的怀疑态度来进行——即这种
cues.en: to be undertaken very, very seriously and with a good deal of skepticism -- that this

cues.zh: 暴力之所以被使用，是因为将会实现一个更正义的结果。
cues.en: violence is being exercised because a more just result is going to be achieved.

cues.zh: 如果没有这种根基，那在我看来就完全不道德。
cues.en: If it does not have that grounding, it is really totally immoral, in my opinion.

cues.zh: 就无产阶级领导阶级斗争的目的而言，
cues.en: As far as the aim of the proletariat in leading a class struggle is concerned,

cues.zh: 我认为仅说它本身是更大的正义，还不够充分。
cues.en: I don't think it would be sufficient to say that it is in itself a greater justice.

cues.zh: 无产阶级通过驱逐统治阶级所将实现的，
cues.en: What the proletariat will achieve by expelling the ruling class

cues.zh: 通过夺取政权所将实现的，恰恰是对阶级权力本身的压制。
cues.en: and by taking power is precisely the suppression of class power in general.

cues.zh: 但那是进一步的正当性论证。
cues.en: But that's the further justification.

cues.zh: 那是正当性论证，人们不是从正义的角度说，而是从权力的角度说。
cues.en: That is the justification, one doesn't speak in terms of justice but in terms of power.

cues.zh: 是从正义的角度；因为将要达成的目的
cues.en: It is in terms of justice; it's because the end that will be achieved

cues.zh: 被主张为一个正义的目的。任何列宁主义者或随便你怎么称呼的人
cues.en: is claimed as a just end. No Leninist or whatever you like

cues.zh: 都不敢说“我们无产阶级有权夺取政权，
cues.en: would dare to say "We, the proletariat, have the right to take power,

cues.zh: 然后把其他所有人扔进焚尸炉。”
cues.en: and then throw everyone else into crematoria."

cues.zh: 如果那就是无产阶级掌权的后果，
cues.en: If that were the consequence of the proletariat taking power,

cues.zh: 那当然不合适。
cues.en: of course it would not be appropriate.

cues.zh: 这个想法是——而且出于我提到的理由，我对此持怀疑态度——
cues.en: The idea is -- and for the reasons I mentioned I'm skeptical about it -

cues.zh: 一段暴力专政时期，或许是暴力的、血腥的专政时期，
cues.en: that a period of violent dictatorship, or perhaps violent and bloody dictatorship,

cues.zh: 是正当的，因为这意味着阶级压迫的沉没与终结，
cues.en: is justified because it means the submergence and termination of class oppression,

cues.zh: 这是人生中应当实现的恰当目标。
cues.en: a proper end to achieve in human life.

cues.zh: 但在我看来，无论如何，正义的概念
cues.en: But it seems to me that, in any case, the notion of justice

cues.zh: 本身在阶级社会中发挥作用，是作为被压迫阶级提出的一种主张，
cues.en: itself functions within a society of classes as a claim

cues.zh: 以及为其所作的辩护。
cues.en: and as a justification for it made by the oppressed class.

cues.zh: 我不同意这一点。
cues.en: I don't agree with that.

cues.zh: 而在无阶级社会中，
cues.en: And in a classless society,

cues.zh: 我不确定我们是否还会使用正义这个概念。
cues.en: I am not sure that we would still use this notion of justice.

cues.zh: 嗯，这里我确实不同意。我认为存在某种绝对的基础
cues.en: Well, here I really disagree. I think there is some sort of an absolute basis

cues.zh: ——如果你逼我太紧，我就会有麻烦，因为我无法把它勾勒出来——
cues.en: -- if you press me too hard I'll be in trouble because I can't sketch it out --

cues.zh: 但某种绝对的基础，最终植根于基本的人类品质之中，
cues.en: but some sort absolute basis, ultimately residing in fundamental human qualities

cues.zh: 据此，一种“真正的”正义概念才得以奠基。
cues.en: in terms of which a "real" notion of justice is grounded.

cues.zh: 我认为，把我们现有的司法体系仅仅描述为阶级压迫体系，未免太草率了。
cues.en: I think it's too hasty to characterize our existing systems of justice

cues.zh: 我不认为它们就是那样的。
cues.en: as merely systems of class oppression; I don't think that they are that.

cues.zh: 我认为它们体现了阶级压迫体系，
cues.en: I think that they embody systems of class oppression

cues.zh: 也体现了其他类型压迫的要素，
cues.en: and they embody elements of other kinds of oppression,

cues.zh: 但它们同时也体现了一种摸索，朝向真正人性化的、
cues.en: but they also embody a kind of a groping towards the true humanly,

cues.zh: 有价值的正义、体面、爱、善良
cues.en: valuable concepts of justice and decency and love and kindness

cues.zh: 同情等等概念，而我认为这些是真实存在的。
cues.en: and sympathy and so on, which I think are real.

cues.zh: 那么，我有时间回答吗？
cues.en: Well, do I have time to answer?

cues.zh: 有。
cues.en: Yes

cues.zh: 多久？因为……
cues.en: How much? Because...

cues.zh: 两分钟？
cues.en: Two minutes?

cues.zh: 但我会说那是不公正的？
cues.en: But I would say that that is unjust?

cues.zh: 绝对如此。
cues.en: Absolutely.

cues.zh: 不，但我不想在这么短的时间里回答。
cues.en: No, but I don't want to answer in so little time.

cues.zh: 我只想说，我不禁认为，人性、
cues.en: I will simply say that I can't help but to think that the concepts of human nature,

cues.zh: 善良、正义、人的本质及其实现……这些概念
cues.en: of kindness, of justice, of human essence and its actualization...

cues.zh: 所有这些都是我们文明内部创造出来的观念和概念，
cues.en: All of these are notions and concepts that have been created within our civilization,

cues.zh: 我们的知识体系和哲学形态，
cues.en: our knowledge system and our form of philosophy,

cues.zh: 因此它们构成了我们阶级体系的一部分；
cues.en: and that as a result they form part of our class system;

cues.zh: 而无论多么令人遗憾，人们都不能提出这些概念
cues.en: and one can't, however regrettable it may be, put forward these concepts

cues.zh: 去描述或辩护一场应当——原则上也必将——
cues.en: to describe or justify a fight which should -- and shall in principle -

cues.zh: 推翻我们社会根本基础的斗争。
cues.en: overthrow the very fundaments of our society.

cues.zh: 这是一项我找不到历史依据的外推。
cues.en: This is an extrapolation for which I can't find the historical justification.

cues.zh: 好，我想我们可以立即开始讨论。
cues.en: Well, I think we can immediately start the discussion.

cues.zh: 乔姆斯基先生，我想问您一个问题。
cues.en: Mr. Chomsky, I would like to ask you one question.

cues.zh: 在您的讨论中，您使用了“无产阶级”这个词，“我们作为无产者”；
cues.en: In your discussion you used the term "proletariat", "we as proletarians";

cues.zh: 历史的讽刺在于，就在年轻知识分子
cues.en: it's the irony of history that the moment young intellectuals

cues.zh: 出身于中产阶级和上层阶级，
cues.en: coming from the middle class and upper class,

cues.zh: 自称无产者并说我们必须加入无产阶级的时候。
cues.en: call themselves proletarians and say we must join the proletariat.

cues.zh: 但我没看到任何有阶级意识的无产者。这是个巨大的困境。
cues.en: But I don't see any class-conscious proletarians. And that's a great dilemma.

cues.zh: 在我们所处的社会里，并非所有人都在做有用的生产性工作，
cues.en: It is not true in our given society that all people are doing useful, productive work,

cues.zh: 或者说自我满足的工作——显然这远非事实。
cues.en: or self-satisfying work -- obviously that's very far from true.

cues.zh: 很多人被排除在生产性劳动的可能性之外。
cues.en: Lots of people are excluded from the possibility of productive labor.

cues.zh: 我认为，这场革命，如果你愿意这么说，应该以全人类的名义进行；
cues.en: And I think the revolution, if you want, should be in the name of all human beings;

cues.zh: 但它必须由某些特定类别的人来领导，而这些人将会是，
cues.en: but it will have to be conducted by certain categories of human beings, and those will be,

cues.zh: 我认为，是真正参与社会生产性工作的人。
cues.en: I think, the human beings who really are involved in the productive work of society.

cues.zh: 至于具体是哪些人，会因社会不同而不同。在我们的社会里，
cues.en: Now what that is will differ, depending upon the society. In our society,

cues.zh: 我认为它包括知识工作者。
cues.en: it I think includes intellectual workers.

cues.zh: 所以我认为学生革命者，如果你愿意这么说，他们有道理，部分道理：
cues.en: So I think that the student revolutionaries, if you like, they have a point, partial point:

cues.zh: 也就是说，在现代先进工业社会中，一个非常重要的问题是
cues.en: that is, it's a very important thing in a modern advanced industrial society how the

cues.zh: 受过训练的知识分子如何认同自己。
cues.en: trained intelligentsia identifies themselves.

cues.zh: 如果他们将成为技术官僚，或成为国家或私人权力的仆从，
cues.en: If they are going to be technocrats, or servants of either the state or private power,

cues.zh: 或者，他们是否将自己认同为劳动力的一部分，
cues.en: or alternatively, whether they are going to identify themselves as part of the workforce,

cues.zh: 恰好从事脑力劳动。
cues.en: who happen to be doing intellectual labor.

cues.zh: 如果是后者，那么他们能够也应该在进步的社会革命中发挥应有的作用。
cues.en: If the latter, then they can and should play a decent role in a progressive social revolution.

cues.zh: 如果是前者，那他们就属于压迫者阶级。
cues.en: If the former, then they're part of the class of the oppressors.

cues.zh: 我还有一个小的补充问题——或者说想对你说一句话。那就是：
cues.en: I have one small additional question -- or rather a remark to make to you. That is:

cues.zh: 你，以你对越南战争极其勇敢的态度，
cues.en: you, with your very courageous attitude towards the war in Vietnam,

cues.zh: 你怎么能在像MIT这样的机构里生存下来，
cues.en: how can you survive in an institution like MIT,

cues.zh: 而MIT在这里被称为大战承包商和这场战争的知识制造者之一？
cues.en: which is known here as one of the Great War contractors and intellectual makers of this war?

cues.zh: 这有两个方面：一是MIT如何容忍我，
cues.en: There are two aspects to that: one is the question how MIT tolerates me,

cues.zh: 另一个问题是我如何容忍MIT。
cues.en: and the other question is how I tolerate MIT.

cues.zh: 至于MIT如何容忍我，这里我要说，还是不要过于简单化地看问题。
cues.en: Well, as to how MIT tolerates me, here again, I think, one shouldn't be overly schematic.

cues.zh: 的确，MIT是一个重要的战争研究机构。
cues.en: It's true that MIT is a major institution of war-research.

cues.zh: 但同样真实的是，它也体现着非常重要的自由意志主义价值观，这些价值观，
cues.en: But it's also true that it embodies very important libertarian values, which are,

cues.zh: 我认为，相当深刻地植根于美国社会，这对世界来说是幸运的。
cues.en: I think, quite deeply embedded in American society, fortunately for the world.

cues.zh: 这些价值观虽然没能深到足以拯救越南人，但已经深到
cues.en: They're not deeply embedded enough to save the Vietnamese, but they're deeply enough

cues.zh: 足以防止更严重的灾难。而在这里，我想还需要稍加限定。
cues.en: embedded to prevent far worse disasters. And here, I think, one has to qualify a bit.

cues.zh: 存在帝国式的恐怖与侵略，存在剥削，存在种族主义，
cues.en: There is imperial terror and aggression, there is exploitation, there is racism,

cues.zh: 诸如此类的事情很多。但同时并存的，还有一种真诚的关切，
cues.en: lots of things like that. But there is also a real concern, coexisting with it,

cues.zh: 关切某种个人权利，比如体现在《权利法案》中的那些权利，
cues.en: for individual rights of a sort which, for example, are embodied in the Bill of Rights,

cues.zh: 而这绝不是简单地表达阶级压迫。
cues.en: which is by no means simply an expression of class oppression.

cues.zh: 这也是一种必要表达：必须保护个人免受国家权力的侵害。
cues.en: It is also an expression of the necessity to defend the individual against state power.

cues.zh: 这些事物是共存的。事情没那么简单，不是全坏或全好。
cues.en: Now these things coexist. It's not that simple, it's not just all bad or all good.

cues.zh: 而正是它们共存时的特定平衡，才使得
cues.en: And it's the particular balance in which they coexist that makes

cues.zh: 一个生产战争武器的机构愿意容忍，事实上，
cues.en: an institute that produces weapons of war be willing to tolerate, in fact,

cues.zh: 在很多方面甚至鼓励，说实话，
cues.en: in many ways even encourage to be quiet honest,

cues.zh: 一个参与反战公民不服从运动的人。
cues.en: a person who is involved in civil disobedience against the war.

cues.zh: 至于我如何容忍MIT，这又引出了另一个问题。
cues.en: Now as to how I tolerate MIT, that raises another question.

cues.zh: 有人主张，而我从来无法理解这其中的逻辑，
cues.en: There are people who argue, and I have never understood the logic of this,

cues.zh: 激进分子应当与一切压迫性机构划清界限。
cues.en: that a radical ought to dissociate himself from all oppressive institutions.

cues.zh: 那个论点的逻辑是，卡尔·马克思不该在大英博物馆学习，
cues.en: The logic of that argument is that Karl Marx shouldn't have studied

cues.zh: 那里无论如何都是世界上最恶劣的帝国主义的象征，
cues.en: in the British Museum which, if anything, was the symbol of the most vicious

cues.zh: 是帝国搜集所有珍宝的地方，
cues.en: imperialism in the world, the place where all the treasures an empire had gathered,

cues.zh: 对殖民地的掠夺，全都倾泻在那里。
cues.en: the rape of the colonies, was all poured in there.

cues.zh: 但我认为卡尔·马克思在大英博物馆做研究是相当正确的。
cues.en: But I think Karl Marx was quite right in studying in the British Museum.

cues.zh: 他利用那个文明的资源和事实上自由主义价值观是正确的，
cues.en: He was right in using the resources and in fact the liberal values

cues.zh: 而他正试图克服那个文明，反过来对抗它。
cues.en: of the civilization that he was trying to overcome, against it.

cues.zh: 我认为这同样适用于当前的情况。
cues.en: And I think the same applies in this case.

cues.zh: 但你不担心你在MIT的存在让他们心安理得吗？
cues.en: But aren't you afraid that your presence at MIT gives them a clean conscience?

cues.zh: 我真不觉得会这样。我是说，我认为我在MIT的存在多少有点作用，
cues.en: I don't see how, really. I mean, I think my presence at MIT serves marginally,

cues.zh: 我希望作用很大，但我不知道有多大，
cues.en: I hope a lot, I don't know how much,

cues.zh: 比如，能增加学生针对MIT所代表的一些事物的行动主义。
cues.en: to increase student activism against a lot of the things that MIT stands for, for example.

cues.zh: 女士们先生们，我想这场辩论必须到此结束了。
cues.en: Ladies and gentlemen, I think this has to be the end of the debate.

cues.zh: 乔姆斯基先生，福柯先生，非常感谢你们深远的讨论，
cues.en: Mr. Chomsky, Mr. Foucault, I thank you very much for your far-reaching discussion

cues.zh: 既涉及哲学和理论问题，也涉及政治问题。
cues.en: both the philosophical and theoretical, as well as the political questions.

cues.zh: 非常感谢你，我代表现场和家里的观众向你致谢。
cues.en: I thank you very much both on behalf of the audience, here and at home.
